If helpful, we can also circulate a clean redline next.

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of [to be agreed] plus benefits customary for similarly situated executives, subject to applicable payroll deductions and withholdings.
edits.name: Compensation placeholder

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. On termination without Cause or by the Executive for Good Reason, the Executive shall receive severance equal to [to be agreed], subject to the Executive’s timely execution and non-revocation of a customary release of claims and continued compliance with restrictive covenants.
edits.name: Severance placeholder

edits.text: 4. NON-COMPETE. For a period of six (6) months following termination of employment, the Executive shall not, within the United States, engage in or provide services to any business that is directly competitive with the Company in a role that is materially similar to the Executive’s role hereunder; provided, however, that this restriction shall not prohibit passive ownership of less than 2% of a publicly traded company or activities not reasonably expected to compete with the Company.
edits.name: Narrowed non-compete
